column1: # approvals.tsv — the ONLY texts the runner sends at a gate. Tab-separated: gate <TAB> exact text <TAB> per-turn CLI allowlist (comma-separated, or -)
# gate = the activePhase of the one state file that went to "awaiting_approval" in the turn that just ended,
#        or "branch" (agent asked to authorise the feature/maintain branch after an Intake or Maintain step).
# HARNESS-FIX 2026-10-31 (kitfix-20261031-gate-commit): every gate is committed by the agent, so every gate's allowlist has
#   Shell(git:commit*) (program phases also Shell(git:tag*)); intake is committed in the branch turn, release squash-merges.
# release-p0a applies to story P0-A only. The text "Approved by mdurana" is sent ONLY by an unattended run.
